sourceFacts: WalletSyncUpdateSchema stores wire.owner unchanged in coin.utxo.owner; it maps tokenType to type, outputIndex to outputNo and decimal value to BigInt.
Sync forwards createdUtxos unchanged through CoreWallet.applyUpdate into UnshieldedState.applyUpdate; availableUtxos retains each original UtxoWithMeta. No owner conversion occurs in this path.

The source08 recovered-wallet fixture used raw hex owner despite the real GraphQL owner encoding. Source08 minted-output comparison expected native hex, so a real available coin owner would fail equality.

Indexer UTXO tokenType and intentHash are hex via const_hex::encode; value is decimal u128 text and outputIndex is u32. Public-data-provider SDK preserves tokenType/intentHash and converts value to BigInt; its transaction UTXO projection omits outputIndex.
Indexer contract balance emits tokenType hex and decimal amount. Public-data-provider SDK maps amount to BigInt balance, matching receipt tokenType/balance expectations.

inference: The unchanged SDK wallet sync path preserves Bech32m owners. The source08 minted guard must normalize this boundary before strict native owner comparison; the raw-hex synthetic wire masked this mismatch.
smallestCorrection: Use the same strict canonical undeployed owner decoder for indexed receipts and available minted wallet output before exact native identity equality. Keep all other minted fields and pending/duplicate checks.
regression: Use reconstructed Bech32m wire with actual WalletSyncUpdateSchema and UnshieldedState application. Assert resulting available owner representation and exact minted predicate; retain malformed/network/checksum/extra-suffix/length/unequal-owner negatives.
adjacentFieldConclusion: No further encoding mismatch found in tokenType, intentHash, outputIndex mapping, values or unshielded balances. SDK receipt outputIndex omission remains an API projection limitation, not a newly normalized field.
